data.mechanism: On the stressed lysosome, TBK1 phosphorylates FNIP1 at S296. This switches the FLCN-FNIP complex off, so mTORC1 can no longer hold TFEB in the cytoplasm and TFEB moves into the nucleus. ULK1 can do the same (ULK1-FNIP1).
data.mechanism_beginner: TBK1 tags FNIP1, which turns FLCN off and lets TFEB escape mTORC1's grip.
data.context: A parallel input to TFEB, not a refutation of canonical TFEB control by mTORC1 (MTORC1-TFEB): it acts by removing FLCN, which mTORC1 needs in order to reach TFEB.
data.boundary: Human cell lines and ATP6V1B2-mutant follicular lymphoma samples (ESP2026); a nutrient-independent lysosomal-stress route. Single study, not yet replicated.
